about: Python/TypeScript parity for the launch update. web/lib/update.ts must reproduce every field of each case's `expected`, reading the same posterior.json and launches.json and the prior samples in `priors`.
u_note: priors[launch_id].u holds the prior samples of the unknown, length n_draws * k_per_draw. Sample i was drawn under posterior draw floor(i / k_per_draw) — that mapping is by construction, so it is not shipped. Feed u in rather than generating it: numpy's Generator is not reproducible in a browser, and every weighted summary downstream depends on the exact values.
sort_note: weighted_quantile sorts with kind='stable'. K samples share each posterior draw so counterfactual values tie exactly, and an unstable sort makes the interpolated quantile depend on tie order (~5e-5 relative).
headline_note: forecast.p_profit_positive is computed from incremental_profit — (mu_forecast - mu_counterfactual) x (price - unit_cost) summed over the horizon minus fixed_cost, differenced inside each sample. total_profit carries the baseline margin of existing cells and is not a verdict for an offer or feature launch.

causal.label: Model-based estimate

assumptions.text: No other change happened in the same weeks.
Untreated cities and groups were not affected.
The demand pattern is stable — nothing shifted the baseline.

causal.recommendation: Keep a random holdout group next time (for example 10% of users get no offer). Then this is an experiment, not a model-based estimate.
